Judah went against the Canaanites who lived in Hebron. (The name of Hebron before that was Kiriath Arba.) They struck…

people.name: Ahiman
people.line: One of the giant descendants of Anak in Hebron

people.name: Anak
people.line: Ancestor of giant people in Canaan

people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

people.name: Hebron
people.line: An important city in Judah; burial place of patriarchs.

translations.web: They went up by the South, and came to Hebron; and Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the children of Anak, were there. (Now Hebron was built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.)
translations.bsb: They went up through the Negev and came to Hebron, where Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the descendants of Anak, dwelled. It had been built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.
translations.kjv: And they ascended by the south, and came unto Hebron; where Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the children of Anak, were. (Now Hebron was built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.)
translations.asv: And they went up by the South, and came unto Hebron; and Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the children of Anak, were there. (Now Hebron was built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.)
